english.note: This is the all-purpose casual way to refer to someone who is driving a motor vehicle, without implying driving is their job.

examples.english: A motorist shouldn't look at their phone while driving.
examples.traditional: 揸車嘅人，揸車嗰陣唔好睇手機。
